title: Stagger Fade Up
description: Elements rise into place one after another as they enter the viewport. The workhorse entrance for lists, card grids and stacked sections.

params.label: Rise distance
params.description: How far below its final position each element starts.

params.label: Duration
params.description: How long a single element takes.

params.label: Stagger
params.description: Delay between one element starting and the next. Zero moves them together.

params.label: Easing
params.description: Ease-out reads as arriving and settling, which is what an entrance should feel like.
